adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces an RSS import path that bypasses Discourse’s normal cooking/sanitization. `Jobs::PollFeed` takes feed item HTML (`CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)`) and passes it to `TopicEmbed.import`. `TopicEmbed.import` creates a post via `PostCreator` with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and `skip_validations: true`, and `Post#cook` explicitly returns `raw` when `cook_method == :raw_html`, skipping the rendering pipeline. The embed view then renders the result with `<%= raw post.cooked %>`. On the RSS path there is no tag/attribute sanitization (unlike `import_remote`, which restricts tags/attributes via ruby-readability), so malicious feed HTML could be stored and served from the forum origin, enabling stored XSS.
